description: [WGS] The Leaders' Meeting, held as part of the World Governments Summit Dialogue for Latin America and the Caribbean, explored ways to strengthen the strategic partnership between the UAE and countries across the region and expand economic and investment cooperation. Discussions focused on translating shared opportunities into projects and partnerships that advance development priorities and mutual interests.
title: Africa: Presidents And Government Leaders Discuss Strengthening Strategic Partnerships And Expanding Cooperation With The UAE

description: [WGS] 10  heads of state and government and international organisations
title: Africa: WGS Dialogue for Latin America and the Caribbean Explores Stronger Cooperation in Shaping the Future

description: [UNAIDS] Geneva/Pretoria -- UNAIDS is deeply saddened by the passing of Dr Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, former United Nations Under-Secretary-General and Executive Director of UN Women, and South Africa's first woman Deputy President, who has died at the age of 71.
title: Africa: UNAIDS Mourns Dr Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, Former Executive Director of UN Women and Champion of the HIV Response

description: [UN] I am deeply saddened by the passing of Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka. She was a lifelong champion of the rights and empowerment of women and girls.
title: Africa: Statement by the Secretary-General - on the Passing of Former UN Women Executive Director Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka

description: [African Union] The Chairperson of the African Union Commission, H.E. Mahmoud Ali Youssouf, has learned with profound sadness of the passing of H.E. Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, former Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa and former Executive Director of UN Women.
title: Africa: The Chairperson of the African Union Commission Pays Tribute to H.E. Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka
